items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I'm talking about things I did with Dinah Shore... No, I was a drummer on those things that she did.

ctx.x: Do you remember what year that was?

Uh huh. Let's see, I think it was '59. Because we went to South America in '60, and that's when Lester passed, in '60. And the people -- that's why I said about music -- when we got to Rio, all these people met us at the airport, and Lester had been deceased for about 3 months, and I was just getting back to myself where I could talk about it, and here at this airport, this jazz club that they have over there -- they met me and interviewed me and started talking about Lester and they just really broke me up all…

Because, you know, what really broke me up was the idea that many miles from the USA, and they still knew my brother, and you know, they just idolized him; all the records, everything. And it's kind of -- it's an education for you because you just do not imagine that people know about you ... as I think I told you about when we first went to England.
